main.description: Who is asking: by the console's session cookie, or their service auth. Nothing, for no one. For the console to show who is signed in, and the other accounts it can switch to.

actor.description: Who is asking, with the handle their DID document names and canCreateGroup; absent when no one is.

accounts.description: The other accounts this browser is signed in to, by the console's cookies, the one used last first, which it can switch to; absent when there are none.

signUpAt.description: The PDS this host signs someone with no account up at (SIGNUP_PDS), as the console's sign-in offers it.
